description: Defines the Theme class within the HTML format namespace, extending BaseConfig to retrieve theme-related configuration values like fonts, CSS, JS, favicon, and templates.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A class for managing theme configuration options in an HTML documentation formatter, extending BaseConfig.

methods.name: getFonts
methods.description: Retrieves the configured fonts for the theme.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Retrieves the configured CSS files or styles.

methods.name: getJS
methods.description: Retrieves the JavaScript files or snippets.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves the templates used in the theme.
